rows.grounds: adjective indicating orientation toward the east
compound naming the street called guṇavīthī
adjective indicating orientation toward the north
indeclinable indicating the same manner or alternative

items.question: What directional orientations are prescribed for the guṇavīthī street?
premises: The guṇavīthī street may be oriented with its tip toward the east.
The guṇavīthī street may likewise be oriented with its tip toward the north.
Both orientations are presented as valid alternatives.
items.inference: The guṇavīthī street is permitted to run either east-pointed or north-pointed.
items.plain_english: The guṇavīthī street may be east-pointed, and likewise it may be north-pointed.
